summary: Shows a serialized field in the Inspector but stops it being edited.
overview: For a live debug view — a current state, a computed value — that should be visible but not hand-edited. The attribute type must live OUTSIDE any Editor folder so scripts using it still compile in a player build; only the drawer is editor-only. That split is forced by Unity, not a style choice.
useCases: Showing a component's current state while it runs.
Displaying a computed value without letting someone break it.
Marking a field that is set by code rather than by hand.

gotchas.title: It only stops the Inspector, not code
gotchas.body: The field is still writable from script, and still serialized. It is a UI hint, not a guarantee.
